h1: Steamboat ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Steamboat grew to 3,741 acres and 181 trails when Mahogany Ridge opened, adding over 650 acres of advanced and expert terrain with rock cliffs and chutes - and making it, in the resort's own words, the second largest ski resort in Colorado. The town below is a working ranching town with hot springs.
stayOverview: The base area is at the gondola; the town is three miles away and has the hot springs, the restaurants and the cheaper beds.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The base area is ski-in; the town needs the free bus or a car.
rentalCars: Steamboat has its own airport at Hayden, 25 miles west, and the town runs a free bus to the mountain.
